    Get information about the configured GROBID server

    grobid_server_info.Rd

    Returns a summary of the current GROBID server configuration (execution mode, URL, version) and tests in real time the availability of the API if a server is configured.

    Usage

    grobid_server_info()

    Value

    An invisible list containing:

    mode

    character. Current execution mode: "docker", "remote" or "not configured" if no server has yet been started or connected.

    url

    character. URL of the configured GROBID server (e.g. "http://localhost:8070"), or NA if no server is configured.

    api_reachable

    logical. TRUE if the GROBID API responds, FALSE otherwise (including if no server is configured).

    grobid_version

    character. GROBID version returned by the server if it is reachable, NA otherwise.

    timeout

    integer. Delay (in seconds) used for the connection test, taken from the current package configuration (see checkrefr_set_defaults()), or NA if no server is configured.

    See also

    grobid_check_requirements() for a full diagnostic of the environment, grobid_docker_start() and grobid_remote_connect() to configure a server, checkrefr_env_status() to check the raw state of the package's internal environment.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
grobid_docker_start()
grobid_server_info()
} # }
